name: errorbar
expr: errorbar(x, y, e); errorbar(x, y, e, e); errorbar(x, y); r1 = 1;
comment: Sig: graphics primitive — errorbar(x, y, err) draws line with symmetric error bars. 4-arg form errorbar(x, y, neg, pos) for asymmetric bars. 2-arg form errorbar(x, y) for plain line. Side-effect (figure emit); spec verifies it runs across the documented arg counts.
